allowed_group_ids.description: QQ group IDs allowed to use Apeiria; empty denies every group

admin_ids.description: QQ user IDs allowed to silence or resume Apeiria

recent_question_limit.description: Number of recent questions excluded from selection

handled_message_limit.description: Maximum number of message IDs retained for deduplication

ai_enabled.description: Enable AI companion replies; requires endpoint, key and model

ai_api_key.description: API key for the AI provider; never commit or log this value

ai_system_prompt.description: Persona system prompt; empty uses the built-in Apeiria prompt

ai_history_retention_days.description: Days to retain local companion context history

ai_prompt_context_limit.description: Maximum archived messages sent to the AI as context
